summary: Verified CaregiverDashboard AtAGlance visual changes on web. UNDER-budget (real Dorothy) shows exactly ONE status label ('Left to spend this quarter', uppercase, primary teal rgb(14,77,82), 15px/700), no separate 'On track/Getting close/...' pill anywhere, big amount $2,322 in primary teal at 60px/600 (≥48px), prominent 'Spent $5,296 · 70% of budget used' row in primary teal 16px/600, and care-management sub-line legible. OVER-budget branch was exercised by intercepting GET /api/budget/current with Playwright and inflating stream spent to 150% of quarterly_gross; after reload label read 'Over budget this quarter' in terracotta rgb(192,57,43), and glance-left amount ($7,187) also rendered in terracotta rgb(192,57,43). Progress bar also switched to terracotta fill. All three acceptance criteria (single label, prominence, conditional red) satisfied.
critical_code_review_comments: AtAGlance.pctUsed is clamped to 100 via Math.min, so the 'N% of budget used' row shows '100% of budget used' when over budget. That's fine visually but hides how far over the participant is. Consider showing the true % (e.g. 194%) when over==true so the red state is quantitatively meaningful. Not a blocker for this bug fix.
seed_data_creation: None. Over-budget branch verified via Playwright route interception of /api/budget/current (no DB mutation).
context_for_next_testing_agent: AtAGlance in /app/frontend/src/pages/CaregiverDashboard.jsx (lines 126-183) drives both the under- and over-budget headline. Under-budget: label + amount are text-primary-k (rgb(14,77,82)); over-budget (left<0): both switch to text-terracotta (rgb(192,57,43)) and label reads 'Over budget this quarter'. The old separate coloured status pill has been removed — do NOT reintroduce a duplicate status element. To reproduce over-budget without a DB user, use Playwright route interception on **/api/budget/current and inflate any stream.spent so sum > quarterly_gross (see iter312 script). Screenshots at /app/test_reports/iter312_under.jpeg and /app/test_reports/iter312_over.jpeg.
